entities.summary: Sergey Gerasimovich Mitin is a Russian politician serving as a Senator from the executive authority of Novgorod Oblast since 2017. Previously, Mitin served as Governor of Novgorod Oblast, Russia from 7 August 2007 to 13 February 2017.
